title: Silver-medalist feed goes person-first: one row per person, roles ranked, reach out
deviations_from_card: (1) Shrunk the new copy to 3 keys (jobs.rediscoveryFeed.alsoClears / roleCount / withheld): Reach out, Reaching, Reached out and the reach title reuse jobs.rediscover.* and refusals reuse pipeline.reachOut.* (useReachOut's sentences) instead of forking them. (2) markPerson is scoped as the critic asked for reach-out (only suppressed_anonymized lifts to the person; a 'suppressed' verdict stays on its pair) but ALSO used for the add door's PIPELINE_ADD_CANDIDATE_WITHHELD refusal (126f10fdd), because that gate is person-level by construction (withheldCandidateIds) and every role on her row would be refused the same way. That is case 8, added while closing the loop; it was written with its implementation, so it was never observed red (cases_red_before counts the card's 7). (3) The header count badge now counts people, not alerts.
notes: Close the loop: the refusals this card receives (reach-out anonymized, reach-out suppressed, the add door's withheld refusal) each remove the refused action from every role the rule covers: a withheld pair or person shows 'Can't be contacted' and no Add / Reach out / Dismiss. No new stored status or server gate.
